title: CPCB Designated Best Use (DBU) water quality criteria for surface waters
source: Central Pollution Control Board, India: Water Quality Criteria (Designated Best Use classification)
verify_note: Transcribed for this prototype. Check every value against the current CPCB publication before using a report for regulatory action.

classes.use: Drinking water source without conventional treatment but after disinfection
Drinking water source after conventional treatment and disinfection
Irrigation, industrial cooling, controlled waste disposal

other_references.note: Nitrate is not part of the CPCB DBU classes. Rising nitrate in a lake points to sewage or fertiliser inputs and drives algal growth well below this limit.
Applies to treated drinking water, not raw lake water; in a lake it is used as a relative indicator.
